verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a local iOS Git client. Its documentation covers cloning to the device, linking Files-app directories, and connecting to self-hosted or private Git servers. That is a user's choice of Git remote, an adjacent feature rather than a documented data-region or residency control. Nothing in the evidence describes choosing a storage region, including for the AI features that send staged diffs to OpenAI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
